title: [2.8.1.1] not reading reservoir from Dana RS consistently
symptom: Two hours after changing set and reservoir AAPS is showing 13 units in pump. Tap Bluetooth icon on Dana tab and it updates to show 278. It is still happening in 2.8.2: after changing cannula and insulin, AAPS picked up the change but reservoir still shows 33u while pump shows 287u.
cause: The full status is read every 30 minutes to save battery, so the reservoir level is not updated immediately after a set change.
fix: Tapping the Bluetooth icon on the Dana tab forces the app to read the Dana and display the correct value. Additionally, the code was changed in the dev branch to read reservoir status more often.
evidence_quote: full status is read every 30 min to save battery.  you can force full read by pressing BT icon anyway I changed code to read reservoir status more often in dev branch
